rows.behavior: In docs/, a relative link resolves from the page's folder: a good one passes and a broken one fails with its file and line.
rows.fails_when: the good link is reported, or the broken one is not reported with file and line under check name link

rows.behavior: In docs/, a link starting with / resolves from the repository root.
rows.fails_when: a / link to an existing repository file is reported, or one to a missing file is not

rows.behavior: In .okf/, a relative link that leaves the bundle is checked.
rows.fails_when: a link like ../src/x.py to a missing file is not reported, or one to an existing file is

rows.behavior: A broken link inside .okf/ is left to the okf validator and not reported.
rows.fails_when: kmctl check reports a broken in-bundle .okf/ link

rows.behavior: URLs and anchors are not checked.
rows.fails_when: an http(s) link or a #anchor link is reported
